statement.zh: 将布拉克眼庙期简单等同于南部乌鲁克「殖民地」或单向行政前哨，仍是可争议的区域互动模型。
statement.en: Equating Brak’s Eye Temple horizon simply with a southern Uruk “colony” or one-way administrative outpost remains a contested regional-interaction model.

disclaimer: Hypothesis / scholarly model — not established fact. Labelled kind=hypothesis.
